items.source: Used for binding to fields with bind(PropertyValues), and not applicable to constructor binding via construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver), which uses only the values it needs.
items.translation: 用于绑定到带有bind(PropertyValues)的字段，不适用于通过construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver)进行的构造函数绑定，后者仅使用其所需的值。

items.source: Registers a corresponding PropertyEditor adapter underneath the covers.
items.translation: 在底层注册一个相应的 PropertyEditor 适配器。

items.source: Conversions from String to any type will typically use the setAsText method of the PropertyEditor class, or a Spring Converter in a ConversionService.
items.translation: 从 String 到任何类型的转换通常使用 `PropertyEditor` 类的 `setAsText` 方法，或者在 `ConversionService` 中的 Spring Converter。

items.source: Convert the value to the required type (if necessary from a String).
items.translation: 将值转换为所需的类型（如有必要，从字符串转换）。

items.source: Return the underlying TypeConverter of this binder's BindingResult.
items.translation: 返回该绑定器的 BindingResult 的底层 TypeConverter。

items.source: requiredType - the type we must convert to (or null if not known, for example in case of a collection element)
items.translation: requiredType - 必须转换的目标类型（或为 null，例如在集合元素的情况下未知）

items.source: value - the value to convert
items.translation: value - 要转换的值

items.source: the new value, possibly the result of type conversion
items.translation: 新值，可能是类型转换的结果

items.source: Used for setter/field injection via bind(PropertyValues), and not applicable to constructor binding via construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver).
items.translation: 用于通过 `bind(PropertyValues)` 进行 setter/字段注入，不适用于通过 `construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver)` 进行的构造函数绑定。

items.source: Note that this setting only applies to binding operations on this DataBinder, not to retrieving values via its BindingResult.
items.translation: 注意，此设置仅适用于此 `DataBinder` 上的绑定操作，不适用于通过其BindingResult检索值。

items.source: More sophisticated matching can be implemented by overriding the isAllowed(String) method.
items.translation: 更复杂的匹配可以通过重写 isAllowed(String) 方法来实现。

items.source: Create the AbstractPropertyBindingResult instance using standard JavaBean property access.
items.translation: 使用标准的 JavaBean 属性访问创建 `AbstractPropertyBindingResult` 实例。

items.source: Create the AbstractPropertyBindingResult instance using direct field access.
items.translation: 使用直接字段访问创建 `AbstractPropertyBindingResult` 实例。

items.source: Return the configured name resolver for constructor parameters.
items.translation: 返回用于构造函数参数的configured名称解析器。

items.source: Return the configured type for the target object.
items.translation: 返回目标对象的configured类型。

items.source: Return the Validators to apply after data binding.
items.translation: 返回数据绑定后应用的验证器。

items.source: formatter - the formatter to add, generically declared for a specific type
items.translation: formatter - 要添加的格式化程序，针对特定类型泛型声明。

items.source: mpvs - the property values to be bound (can be modified)
items.translation: mpvs - 要绑定的属性值（可修改）

items.source: Custom validation errors can be added afterwards. You will typically want to resolve such error codes into proper user-visible error messages; this can be achieved through resolving each error via a MessageSource, which is able to resolve an ObjectError/FieldError through its MessageSource.getMessage(org.springframework.context.MessageSourceResolvable, java.util.Locale) method. The list of message codes can be customized through the MessageCodesResolver strategy: see the setMessageCodesResolver(MessageCodesResolver) method. DefaultMessageCodesResolver's javadoc states details on the default resolution rules.
items.translation: 可以随后添加自定义验证错误。您通常希望将这些错误代码解析为适当的用户可见错误消息；这可以通过通过 MessageSource 解析每个错误来实现，该接口能够通过其 MessageSource.getMessage(org.springframework.context.MessageSourceResolvable, java.util.Locale) 方法解析 ObjectError/FieldError。消息代码列表可以通过 MessageCodesResolver 策略进行自定义：请参阅 setMessageCodesResolver(MessageCodesResolver) 方法。DefaultMessageCodesResolver 的 JavaDoc 说明了默认解析规则的详细信息。

items.source: The binding results can be examined via the BindingResult interface, extending the Errors interface: see the getBindingResult() method. Missing fields and property access exceptions will be converted to FieldErrors, collected in the Errors instance, using the following error codes:
items.translation: 绑定结果可以通过扩展Errors接口的BindingResult接口进行检查：参见getBindingResult()方法。缺失的字段和属性访问异常将转换为FieldErrors，并使用以下错误代码收集到 Errors 实例中：

items.source: If the target object is null and getTargetType() is set, then construct(ValueResolver) may be called to create the target.
items.translation: 如果目标对象为 `null` 且已设置 `getTargetType()`，则可能会调用 `construct(ValueResolver)` 来创建目标。

items.source: By default, binding errors get resolved through the BindingErrorProcessor strategy, processing for missing fields and property access exceptions: see the setBindingErrorProcessor(BindingErrorProcessor) method. You can override the default strategy if needed, for example to generate different error codes.
items.translation: 默认情况下，绑定错误通过 BindingErrorProcessor 策略进行解析，处理缺失字段和属性访问异常：请参见setBindingErrorProcessor(BindingErrorProcessor) 方法。如有需要，您可以覆盖默认策略，例如生成不同的错误代码。

items.source: Used for binding to fields with bind(PropertyValues), and not applicable to constructor binding via construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver) which uses only the values it needs.
items.translation: 用于绑定到带有bind(PropertyValues)的字段，不适用于通过construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver)进行的构造函数绑定，后者仅使用其所需的值。

items.source: Supports "xxx*", "*xxx", "*xxx*", and "xxx*yyy" matches (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts), as well as direct equality.
items.translation: 支持 `"xxx*"`、`"*xxx"`、`"*xxx*"` 以及 `"xxx*yyy"` 等匹配（包含任意数量的模式部分），同时也支持直接相等。

items.source: Supports "xxx*", "*xxx", "*xxx*", and "xxx*yyy" matches (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts), as well as direct equality.
items.translation: 支持 `"xxx*"`、`"*xxx"`、`"*xxx*"` 和 `"xxx*yyy"` 等匹配（包含任意数量的模式部分），以及直接相等。

items.source: After the call, use getBindingResult() to check for failures to bind to, and/or validate constructor arguments. If there are no errors, the target is set, and doBind(MutablePropertyValues) can be used for further initialization via setters.
items.translation: 调用后，使用 `getBindingResult()` 检查绑定和/或验证构造函数参数是否失败。如果没有错误，则目标已设置，可以使用 `doBind(MutablePropertyValues)` 通过 setter 进行进一步初始化。

items.source: Checks for "xxx*", "*xxx", "*xxx*", and "xxx*yyy" matches (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts), as well as direct equality, in the configured lists of allowed field patterns and disallowed field patterns.
items.translation: 检查配置中允许的字段模式和禁止的字段模式列表中，是否存在 `"xxx*"`、`"*xxx"`、`"*xxx*"` 和 `"xxx*yyy"` 等匹配（支持任意数量的模式部分），以及直接相等的情况。

items.source: WARNING: Data binding can lead to security issues by exposing parts of the object graph that are not meant to be accessed or modified by external clients. Therefore, the design and use of data binding should be considered carefully with regard to security. For more details, please refer to the dedicated sections on data binding for Spring Web MVC and Spring WebFlux in the reference manual.
items.translation: 警告： 数据绑定可能导致安全问题，因为它会暴露外部客户端不应访问或修改的对象图部分。因此，在设计和使用数据绑定时，应仔细考虑其安全性。有关详细信息，请参阅参考手册中关于 Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 的数据绑定专用章节： Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux。

items.source: The default implementation of this method stores disallowed field patterns in canonical form, and subsequently pattern matching in isAllowed(String) is case-insensitive. Subclasses that override this method must therefore take this transformation into account.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现将不允许的字段模式存储在canonical形式中，随后在isAllowed(String)中进行的大小写不敏感的模式匹配。因此，重写此方法的子类必须考虑这种转换。

items.source: If not configured, or if the name cannot be resolved, by default DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer is used.
items.translation: 如果未配置，或者无法解析名称，默认使用 DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer。

items.source: The default implementation of this method stores allowed field patterns in canonical form. Subclasses which override this method must therefore take this into account.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现将允许的字段模式存储在规范形式中。因此，覆盖此方法的子类必须考虑这一点。

items.source: Alternatively, specify a list of disallowed field patterns.
items.translation: 或者，指定一个不允许的字段模式列表。

items.source: Alternatively, specify a list of allowed field patterns.
items.translation: 或者，指定一个允许的字段模式列表。

items.source: Uses a public, no-arg constructor if available in the target object type, also supporting a "primary constructor" approach for data classes as follows: It understands the JavaBeans ConstructorProperties annotation as well as runtime-retained parameter names in the bytecode, associating input values with constructor arguments by name. If no such constructor is found, the default constructor will be used (even if not public), assuming subsequent bean property bindings through setter methods.
items.translation: 如果目标对象类型中存在公共无参构造函数，则使用它；同时也支持数据类的“主构造函数”方式，如下所示：它理解 JavaBeans `<code>ConstructorProperties` 注解以及字节码中运行时保留的参数名，通过名称将输入值与构造函数参数关联。如果找不到此类构造函数，则将使用默认构造函数（即使不是公共的），假设后续将通过 setter 方法进行 bean 属性绑定。

items.source:
The binding process can be customized by specifying allowed field patterns,
required fields, custom editors, etc.
items.translation: 绑定过程可以通过指定允许的字段模式、必需字段、自定义编辑器等进行定制。

items.source: This generic data binder can be used in any kind of environment.
items.translation: 该通用数据绑定器可用于任何类型的环境。

items.source:
If "true", a null path location will be populated with a default object value and traversed
instead of resulting in an exception. This flag also enables auto-growth of collection elements
when accessing an out-of-bounds index.
items.translation: 如果为"true"，则空路径位置将被填充默认对象值并进行遍历，而不是抛出异常。此标志还启用了在访问越界索引时自动增长集合元素。

items.source:
Default is "true" on a standard DataBinder. Note that since Spring 4.1 this feature is supported
for bean property access (DataBinder's default mode) and field access.
items.translation: 默认情况下，标准 DataBinder 的值为 "true"。请注意，自 Spring 4.1 起，此功能已支持 Bean 属性访问（DataBinder 的默认模式）和字段访问。

items.source:
Default is 256, preventing OutOfMemoryErrors in case of large indexes.
Raise this limit if your auto-growing needs are unusually high.
items.translation: 默认值为 256，可防止大型索引出现 OutOfMemoryError。如果您的自动增长需求异常高，请提高此限制。

items.source: This is the default; an explicit call just leads to eager initialization.
items.translation: 这是默认行为；显式调用只会导致急切初始化。

items.source:
Default is "false". Turn this on to limit binding to constructor
parameters and allowed fields.
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。打开此选项可将绑定限制为构造函数参数和允许的字段。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off to enforce that all bind parameters
must have a matching field in the target object.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。关闭此选项可强制要求所有绑定参数在目标对象中必须有对应的字段。

items.source:
Default is "false". Turn this on to ignore bind parameters for
nested objects in non-existing parts of the target object graph.
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。打开此选项可忽略目标对象图中不存在的部分中嵌套对象的绑定参数。

items.source: Default is all fields.
items.translation: 默认值为所有字段。

items.source:
Restrict this for example to avoid unwanted modifications by malicious
users when binding HTTP request parameters.
items.translation: 限制此示例，以避免恶意用户在绑定 HTTP 请求参数时进行不需要的修改。

items.source:
Mark fields as disallowed, for example to avoid unwanted
modifications by malicious users when binding HTTP request parameters.
items.translation: 将字段标记为不允许，例如在绑定 HTTP 请求参数时，以避免恶意用户进行不需要的修改。

items.source:
If one of the specified fields is not contained in the list of
incoming property values, a corresponding "missing field" error
will be created, with error code "required" (by the default
binding error processor).
items.translation: 如果指定的字段之一不在传入属性值列表中，将由默认绑定错误处理器创建一个相应的“缺少字段”错误，其错误代码为"required"。

items.source: Default is a DefaultMessageCodesResolver.
items.translation: 默认值为 DefaultMessageCodesResolver。

items.source: Default is a DefaultBindingErrorProcessor.
items.translation: 默认值为 DefaultBindingErrorProcessor。

items.source:
By default, simple value types, maps, collections, and arrays are
excluded from nested constructor binding initialization.
items.translation: 默认情况下，简单值类型、映射、集合和数组被排除在嵌套构造函数绑定初始化之外。

items.source:
This call can create field errors, representing basic binding
errors like a required field (code "required"), or type mismatch
between value and bean property (code "typeMismatch").
items.translation: 此调用可创建字段错误，表示基本绑定错误，例如必填字段（代码"required"），或值与 Bean 属性之间的类型不匹配（代码"typeMismatch"）。

items.source:
Note that the given PropertyValues should be a throwaway instance:
For efficiency, it will be modified to just contain allowed fields if it
implements the MutablePropertyValues interface; else, an internal mutable
copy will be created for this purpose. Pass in a copy of the PropertyValues
if you want your original instance to stay unmodified in any case.
items.translation:
注意，给定的 PropertyValues 应为一个一次性实例：
为了提高效率，如果它实现了 MutablePropertyValues 接口，它将仅包含允许字段；否则，将为此目的创建一个内部可变副本。如果您希望原始实例在任何情况下都保持不变，请传入 PropertyValues 的副本。

items.source: Invoked for each passed-in property value.
items.translation: 对每个传入的属性值调用。

items.source:
Matching against allowed field patterns is case-sensitive; whereas,
matching against disallowed field patterns is case-insensitive.
items.translation: 与允许的字段模式匹配是区分大小写的；而与不允许的字段模式匹配则不区分大小写。

items.source:
A field matching a disallowed pattern will not be accepted even if it
also happens to match a pattern in the allowed list.
items.translation: 与不允许的模式匹配的字段将不会被接受，即使它同时也匹配允许列表中的某个模式。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses, but care must be taken to honor the
aforementioned contract.
items.translation: 可以在子类中被重写，但必须注意遵守上述约定。

items.source:
Default implementation applies all the supplied property
values as bean property values. By default, unknown fields will
be ignored.
items.translation: 默认实现会将所有提供的属性值作为 Bean 属性值。默认情况下，未知字段将被忽略。

items.source: Note: Validation hints may get ignored by the actual target Validator.
items.translation: 注意：实际的验证器可能会忽略这些验证提示。

items.source: Return the Validators to apply after data binding. This includes the configured validators filtered by the exclude predicate.
items.translation: 返回数据绑定后应用的验证器。这包括经过排除谓词过滤后的已配置validators。

items.source: Whether to not bind parameters to properties. Returns "true" if isDeclarativeBinding() is on, and allowedFields are not configured.
items.translation: 是否不将参数绑定到属性。如果 isDeclarativeBinding() 为开，且 allowedFields 未配置，则返回 "true"。

items.source: Set the type for the target object. When the target is null, setting the targetType allows using construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver) to create the target.
items.translation: 设置目标对象的类型。当目标为 `null` 时，设置 `targetType` 允许使用 construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver) 来创建目标。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：PropertyEditorRegistry

items.source: Strategy for constructor binding to look up the values to bind to a given constructor parameter.
items.translation: 用于查找要绑定到给定构造函数参数的值的构造函数绑定策略。

items.source: Add a custom formatter, applying it to all fields matching the Formatter-declared type.
items.translation: 添加一个自定义格式化器，并将其应用于所有匹配 `Formatter` 声明类型的字段。

items.source: Add a custom formatter, applying it to the specified field types only, if any, or otherwise to all fields matching the Formatter-declared type.
items.translation: 添加自定义格式化器，如果指定了字段类型，则仅应用于这些字段；否则，应用于所有匹配 `Formatter` 声明类型的字段。

items.source: Add a custom formatter for the field type specified in Formatter class, applying it to the specified fields only, if any, or otherwise to all fields.
items.translation: 为在 `Formatter` 类中指定的字段类型添加自定义格式化器，如果指定了特定字段则仅应用于这些字段，否则应用于所有字段。

items.source: Specify a ConversionService to use for converting property values, as an alternative to JavaBeans PropertyEditors.
items.translation: 指定一个用于转换属性值的 `ConversionService`，作为 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的替代方案。

items.source: Set whether to bind only fields explicitly intended for binding including: Constructor binding via construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver).
items.translation: 设置是否仅绑定明确用于绑定的字段，包括：通过 `construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver)` 进行的构造函数绑定。

items.source: Configure a resolver to determine the name of the value to bind to a constructor parameter in construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver).
items.translation: 配置一个解析器，用于确定要绑定到构造函数参数的值的名称，在construct(DataBinder.ValueResolver)中。

items.source: Return the field patterns that should not be allowed for binding.
items.translation: 返回不应允许用于绑定的字段模式。

items.source: Default limit for array and collection growing: 256.
items.translation: 数组和集合增长的默认限制：256。

items.source: Default object name used for binding: "target".
items.translation: 默认用于绑定的对象名称为："target"。

items.source: We'll create a lot of DataBinder instances: Let's use a static logger.
items.translation: 我们将创建大量的 DataBinder 实例：让我们使用一个静态日志记录器。

items.source: Create a new DataBinder instance, with default object name.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 DataBinder 实例，使用默认对象名称。

items.source: Create a new DataBinder instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 DataBinder 实例。

items.source: Add Validators to apply after each binding step.
items.translation: 添加验证器以在每个绑定步骤后应用。

items.source:
Check the given property values against the allowed fields,
removing values for fields that are not allowed.
items.translation: 检查给定的属性值与允许字段，移除不允许字段的值。

items.source:
Check the given property values against the required fields,
generating missing field errors where appropriate.
items.translation: 检查给定的属性值与必需字段，在适当时生成缺失字段错误。

items.source:
Close this DataBinder, which may result in throwing
a BindException if it encountered any errors.
items.translation: 关闭此 DataBinder，如果它遇到任何错误，可能会抛出 BindException。

items.source:
Actual implementation of the binding process, working with the
passed-in MutablePropertyValues instance.
items.translation: 绑定过程的实际实现，处理传入的 MutablePropertyValues 实例。

items.source: Find a custom property editor for the given type and property.
items.translation: 查找给定类型和属性的自定义属性编辑器。

items.source: Return the field patterns that should be allowed for binding.
items.translation: 返回允许用于绑定的字段模式。

items.source: Return the current limit for array and collection auto-growing.
items.translation: 返回数组和集合自动增长的当前限制。

items.source: Return the strategy for processing binding errors.
items.translation: 返回绑定错误的处理策略。

items.source: Return the associated ConversionService, if any.
items.translation: 返回关联的 ConversionService（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the internal BindingResult held by this DataBinder,
as an AbstractPropertyBindingResult.
items.translation: 返回此 DataBinder 持有的内部 BindingResult，作为 AbstractPropertyBindingResult。

items.source: Return the name of the bound object.
items.translation: 返回绑定对象的名称。

items.source: Return the underlying PropertyAccessor of this binder's BindingResult.
items.translation: 返回此绑定器（Binder）的绑定结果（BindingResult）的基础属性访问器（PropertyAccessor）。

items.source: Return the fields that are required for each binding process.
items.translation: 返回每个绑定过程所需的字段。

items.source: Return this binder's underlying SimpleTypeConverter.
items.translation: 返回该绑定器的底层 SimpleTypeConverter。

items.source: Return the primary Validator to apply after each binding step, if any.
items.translation: 返回每个绑定步骤之后要应用的主要验证器（如果有）。

items.source:
Initialize direct field access for this DataBinder,
as alternative to the default bean property access.
items.translation: 为此 DataBinder 初始化直接字段访问，作为默认 Bean 属性访问的替代方案。

items.source: Return whether "auto-growing" of nested paths has been activated.
items.translation: 返回嵌套路径的“自动增长”是否已激活。

items.source: Return whether to bind only fields intended for binding.
items.translation: 返回是否仅绑定用于绑定的字段。

items.source: Return whether to ignore invalid fields when binding.
items.translation: 返回在绑定时是否忽略无效字段。

items.source: Return whether to ignore unknown fields when binding.
items.translation: 返回在绑定时是否忽略未知字段。

items.source: Register the given custom property editor for all properties of the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型的所有属性注册给定的自定义属性编辑器。

items.source: Replace the Validators to apply after each binding step.
items.translation: 将验证器替换为在每个绑定步骤后应用的验证器。

items.source: Configure a predicate to exclude validators.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词以排除验证器。

items.source: Set the Validator to apply after each binding step.
items.translation: 将验证器设置为在每个绑定步骤之后应用。

items.source: Invoke the specified Validators, if any.
items.translation: 调用指定的验证器（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the BindingResult instance created by this DataBinder.
This allows for convenient access to the binding results after
a bind operation.
items.translation:
返回此 DataBinder 创建的 BindingResult 实例。
这允许在绑定操作后方便地访问绑定结果。

items.source: If the property path denotes an array or Collection property, the editor will get applied either to the array/Collection itself (the PropertyEditor has to create an array or Collection value) or to each element (the PropertyEditor has to create the element type), depending on the specified required type.
items.translation: 如果属性路径表示数组或集合属性，编辑器将应用于该数组/集合本身（`PropertyEditor 必须创建数组或集合值），或者应用于每个元素（`PropertyEditor` 必须创建元素类型），具体取决于指定的所需类型。

items.source: Default is none.
items.translation: 默认值为无。

items.source:
Note: Only one single registered custom editor per property path
is supported. In the case of a Collection/array, do not register an editor
for both the Collection/array and each element on the same property.
items.translation: 注意：每个属性路径仅支持注册一个自定义编辑器。对于集合/数组，请勿在同一属性上为集合/数组及其每个元素同时注册编辑器。

items.source:
For example, if you wanted to register an editor for "items[n].quantity"
(for all values n), you would use "items.quantity" as the value of the
'propertyPath' argument to this method.
items.translation: 例如，如果您想为"items[n].quantity"（所有 n 值）注册一个编辑器，您会将"items.quantity"用作此方法的`propertyPath`参数的值。

items.source: Set the strategy to use for processing binding errors, that is, required field errors and PropertyAccessExceptions.
items.translation: 设置用于处理绑定错误的策略，即必需字段错误和PropertyAccessExceptions。

items.translation: 将给定的属性值应用到目标对象。

items.translation: 将给定的属性值绑定到此绑定器的目标。

items.source:
Register the given custom property editor for the given type and
property, or for all properties of the given type.
items.translation: 为给定的类型和属性注册指定的自定义属性编辑器，或为该类型的全部属性注册。

items.source: Register field patterns that should be allowed for binding.
items.translation: 注册允许用于绑定的字段模式。

items.source: Specify the limit for array and collection auto-growing.
items.translation: 指定数组和集合自动增长的阈值。

items.source: Set whether this binder should attempt to "auto-grow" a nested path that contains a null value.
items.translation: 设置此绑定器是否应尝试“自动扩展”包含 null 值的嵌套路径。

items.source:
Set whether to ignore invalid fields, that is, whether to ignore bind
parameters that have corresponding fields in the target object which are
not accessible (for example because of null values in the nested path).
items.translation: 设置是否忽略无效字段，即是否忽略目标对象中具有对应字段但不可访问的绑定参数（例如由于嵌套路径中的空值导致）。

items.source:
Set whether to ignore unknown fields, that is, whether to ignore bind
parameters that do not have corresponding fields in the target object.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略未知字段，即是否忽略目标对象中没有对应字段的绑定参数。

items.source: Set the strategy to use for resolving errors into message codes.
items.translation: 设置用于将错误解析为消息代码的策略。

items.source: Register fields that are required for each binding process.
items.translation: 注册每个绑定过程所需的字段。

items.source: Set the type for the target object.
items.translation: 设置目标对象的类型。

items.source:
Whether to instantiate the constructor argument of the given type,
matching its own constructor arguments to bind values.
items.translation: 是否实例化给定类型的构造函数参数，通过匹配其自身的构造函数参数来绑定值。

items.source: Whether to not bind parameters to properties.
items.translation: 是否不将参数绑定到属性。

items.source: Invoke the specified Validators, if any, with the given validation hints.
items.translation: 调用指定的验证器（如果有），并传入给定的验证提示。

items.source: requiredType - the type of the property. This may be null if a property is given but should be specified in any case, in particular in case of a Collection - making clear whether the editor is supposed to apply to the entire Collection itself or to each of its entries. So as a general rule: Do not specify null here in case of a Collection/array!
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型。如果给出了属性，但必须指定（特别是在集合的情况下），则此值可能为 null，以明确编辑器是应用于整个集合本身还是其每个条目。因此，一般规则如下：对于集合/数组，请勿在此处指定 null！

items.source: requiredType - the type of the property (can be null if a property is given but should be specified in any case for consistency checking)
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型（如果已提供属性，该值可以为 null，但为了保持一致性检查，在任何情况下都应指定）

items.source: propertyPath - the path of the property (name or nested path), or null if looking for an editor for all properties of the given type
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性的路径（名称或嵌套路径），或者如果正在查找给定类型所有属性的编辑器，则为 null。

items.source: methodParam - the method parameter that is the target of the conversion (for analysis of generic types; may be null)
items.translation: methodParam - 转换的目标方法参数（用于泛型类型的分析；可能为 null）

items.source: field - the reflective field that is the target of the conversion (for analysis of generic types; may be null)

items.source: typeDescriptor - the type descriptor to use (may be null))
items.translation: typeDescriptor - 要使用的类型描述符（可为 null）

items.translation: objectName - 目标对象的名称

items.source: requiredType - the type of the property
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型
